title: Leaved
summary: LE'AVED, adjective [from leaf; but leafed would be preferable.] 1. Furnished with foliage or leaves. 2. Having a leaf, or made with leaves or folds; as a two-leaved gate.

inlines.v: LE'AVED, adjective [from leaf; but leafed would be preferable.] 1. Furnished with foliage or leaves. 2. Having a leaf, or made with leaves or folds; as a two-leaved gate.
